Key responsibilities include:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define strategies and plans for the test effort as well as lead, guide and monitor test design, implementation, traceability and execution
  • Perform resource planning and estimatation for the test effort
  • Collaborate with appropriate stakeholders to procure and ready a test environment
  • Schedule test execution as well as measure, monitor and report test progress, solution quality and test results
Test manager or test coordinator are other commonly known titles for this role.
